objects.name: Numbered bank "auth gateways": one generator, 18 brands, an empty page for anyone without the link
objects.description: Between 27 October and 16 November 2026 one generator bought 48 names such as 42708-fifth-third-auth-gateway[.]icu, 46208-capone-auth-gateway[.]icu and 94709-citi-auth-gateway[.]credit: a number, a bank or carrier and a word like "auth gateway" or "identity verif", on cheap domain endings. Every one of them uses the same DNS service, and on 16 November 47 resolved to a pool of 13 small rented servers where names of different banks share the same address. 15 of the 21 names NSS tried answered with an empty page at the root, consistent with content served only on the message link; one led to a picture puzzle. On 16 November none of the 48 was on a threat list NSS takes in. Read again two days later, 44 of the 48 still answered on the same 13 servers, three had gone to a registry hold, still none was on a list, and the generator had bought six more names, two of them in a shape that reads as a credit union's own fraud-prevention line.
